prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one whole-tree front-view source photograph for a 3D model, NOT the 3D model itself.
Primary request: Generate ONE entirely NEW image of the specified tree. The two supplied reference pictures are appearance and rich foliage palette references ONLY; they show the palace setting in which the tree will eventually appear. Do not reproduce their buildings, people, paving, aerial view or dramatic sunlight.
Style/medium: convincing real-camera botanical catalog photograph, realistic irregular bark and individually believable foliage; naturally varied small details, no repeated procedural pattern, no painterly or plastic surface.
Scene/backdrop: plain neutral light gray seamless background, uniform and unobtrusive, visible through natural gaps between branches. No scene or landscape.
Camera/composition: full isolated single tree viewed directly from the front, vertical trunk and undistorted proportions, long-lens photographic perspective. The complete crown, every outer branch and the very bottom of the trunk fit inside a portrait canvas with comfortable clear margins. No close-up, no panel layout, no crop.
Lighting: soft even diffuse illumination, enough light to distinguish the bark and foliage, no hard cast shadows, no backlighting or golden-hour highlights.
Foliage: dark richly saturated natural green, never fluorescent lime. An elevated, irregular airy crown with visible branch structure, natural gaps and finely broken edges. No low blob crown, no smooth rounded foliage balls, no topiary, no bonsai. Preserve a clearly exposed slim trunk below the first branches all the way to its base.
Root/base constraint: the narrow trunk stops cleanly at the invisible ground level. NO raised surface roots, root ball, wide buttress roots, root pedestal, soil clod, ground slab, mound, pot or planter. Do not show soil, pavement, a horizon or a supporting platform.
No human or emperor, no other tree, no architecture, no labels, measurements, scale bar, graphic text, logo or watermark. Specified metric values below describe proportional targets only, never print them in the image.

Subject: a mature old oriental arborvitae, Platycladus orientalis. ONE tall tree with a slender weathered twisting trunk and naturally furrowed bark. Proportion target: total height 12 m; trunk diameter 0.6 m, base never wider than 0.9 m. Lowest living branches begin 3.5 m above the base (about the lower 29 percent of total height stays a visible bare trunk). Crown 4.5 m wide, narrow upright column tapering to an irregular conical top. Natural scale-leaf sprays on branching limbs, mature and irregular rather than a dense garden hedge. Crown light enough to reveal glimpses of major branches. No low shrub shape.
intent: whole new generation using appearance references
